description: Lists the bookmaker and exchange keys of one region, the values odds, raw_odds, event_odds, history and coverage take. Serves every region, one region code a call; the exchanges are in the UK & Ireland (uk) only. Costs no tokens.

region.description: One region code from the regions tool, such as uk or us. Left out, the API uses uk, or refuses with region_required and names the code to send.
